desc:
A store speed check with fixes for slow pages tests your most important pages on mobile and desktop, then repairs what makes them heavy. Ecom Swift LLC tests before and after, so you can see what changed.

## What is a store speed check?

A store speed check measures how quickly your key pages load and become usable, then identifies the causes of delay. We test the home page, a collection, a product page and the cart. For each, we look at image weight, fonts, scripts, apps and the way the theme loads its files. The check ends with fixes for the cheapest wins and a list of larger options.

## Why slow pages lose shoppers quietly

A visitor who waits does not complain. They go back to the search results and choose another store. Phones on mobile networks make the problem worse, because a page that feels fine on an office connection can crawl on a train.

Slow pages usually come from ordinary choices. A full-size photo uploaded straight from a camera. Three fonts where one would do. A chat widget, a review app and a pop-up tool, each loading its own scripts. None looks serious alone, and together they add seconds.

## How faster pages help results

A page that appears quickly lets a shopper begin looking at products straight away. That keeps more visitors on the site and gives the rest of your design a chance to work. Search engines also take page experience into account, so a lighter store gives them less reason to mark your pages down.

We do not promise a particular score or ranking. The outcome depends on your theme, your catalog and the apps you rely on. What we can say is that removing needless weight helps in nearly every case, and the before and after scores show how far it went.

## What a good speed check includes

- Tests of key pages on both phone and desktop.
- Measurement of the largest image or block on each page.
- Image compression and correct sizing.
- Modern image formats where your platform supports them.
- Review of fonts and how they load.
- A list of scripts and apps that add weight.
- Delay of scripts that are not needed straight away.
- Video and embed loading improved, so they do not block the page.
- A repeat test to confirm the changes held.
- A plain report with scores and recommendations.

## What we do

We run the tests first and keep the results as your starting point. Then we work through the causes in order of payoff. Images come first, because they are the commonest source of weight and the safest to fix. Next are fonts, then scripts and theme code. We do this in your own store, usually on a theme copy before the live one.

Compression is set to keep photos sharp, and we look at the results on a phone before approving them. When an app is the cause, we do not remove it without your say. We list it with the effect it has and suggest lighter options. Basic covers a few pages and a few quick fixes. Standard covers more pages and adds app and script findings. Premium goes deeper, reviews the image library, repeats the test a week later and gives you a plan for the next quarter. Regular checks can be quoted separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Resize photos before upload to the size they will be shown.
- Limit your store to one or two fonts.
- Check speed on a phone using a mobile connection.
- Test again after installing any new app.
- Keep video hosted on a platform and embedded, not uploaded in full.

**Avoid:**
- Chasing a perfect score at the cost of how the store looks.
- Putting several pop-ups and widgets on the same page.
- Uploading images straight from a camera.
- Auto-playing background video on the home page.
- Judging speed from a single test on a single device.

## Who this is for

This suits a store owner who feels the site is slow and cannot say why. It suits a seller who has added many apps and photos over time. It also suits a business that pays for ads and wants the pages visitors land on to load quickly.

## What we need from you

Your store address and the pages you care about most, plus access as a collaborator, staff or admin user. We never need passwords. Tell us about any app you cannot live without, so we leave it in place and look for other savings.
